overallVerdict: Solid structural narrative and tactical breakdowns; needs freeze-frame analytical pauses and removal of duplicate play restarts to match FTL standards.

topProblems.problem: Atlanta play loops into a close-up slow motion without a freeze-frame cue or spotlight overlay.
topProblems.fix: Insert a freeze frame at 00:34 on the high-show defender before resuming slow motion.

topProblems.problem: Split-screen comparison between ATL and MIN lacks visual labels or highlight indicators.
topProblems.fix: Add subtle freeze-frame pauses on both screens at the moment second defenders load.

topProblems.problem: Montage transitions quickly between three different game sources without explicit visual anchors.
topProblems.fix: Hold a 1-second freeze at each pickup location to emphasize distance differences.

topProblems.problem: Vertical crop ratio on Portland clip creates unnecessary black pillar-bars on 16:9 frame.
topProblems.fix: Re-frame vertical clip into a clean 3:4 or padded blur container.
